NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
SERVICE_NOT_READY: The server is starting up. Please try again shortly.
NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you asked for.
INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into an error.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: That's more than the server takes at once. Send something smaller.
AUTH_EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
AUTH_PASSWORD_POLICY: The password doesn't meet the requirements.
AUTH_REGISTRATION_NOT_ALLOWED: This email isn't invited. Ask your administrator to add it.
AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account is disabled. Contact your administrator.
AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
AUTH_GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID: Google sign-in couldn't be verified. Try again.
AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
AUTH_REFRESH_REUSED: You were signed out for your security. Please sign in again.
AUTH_SESSION_REVOKED: You've been signed out. Please sign in again.
AGENT_SKILL_NOT_FOUND: The assistant doesn't have that skill.
AGENT_INPUT_TOO_LONG: That request is too long. Please shorten it.
AGENT_PROPOSAL_CLOSED: This change was already handled or has expired.
VERSION_CONFLICT: This was changed somewhere else. Reload it and try again.
EXPENSE_CATEGORY_INVALID: Choose one of your categories for this kind of entry.
EXPENSE_CATEGORY_EXISTS: You already have a category with this name.
EXPENSE_CATEGORY_LIMIT: You have reached the limit of your own categories.
EXPENSE_PRODUCT_EXISTS: You already follow a product with this name.
EXPENSE_PRODUCT_NAME_TAKEN: Another product already goes by this name. Combine them instead.
EXPENSE_PRODUCT_LIMIT: You follow as many products as you can.
EXPENSE_PRODUCT_INVALID: That can't be done with these products.
EXPENSE_BUDGET_LIMIT: You have as many budgets as you can. Delete one you no longer need.
EXPENSE_SAVED_FILTER_EXISTS: You already have a view with this name.
EXPENSE_SAVED_FILTER_LIMIT: You have as many views as you can keep. Delete one you no longer use.
EXPENSE_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: That's more entries than one file can take. Choose a shorter period.
EXPENSE_IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: That file is longer than one import can take. Split it by period.
EXPENSE_IMPORT_UNREADABLE: That file can't be read as a CSV file.
EXPENSE_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: An entry keeps the currency it was made in.
FX_UNAVAILABLE: Exchange rates can't be reached right now. Try again shortly, or save it in your own currency.
FX_CURRENCY_UNSUPPORTED: There is no exchange rate for this currency.
EXPENSE_CONTRIBUTION_INVALID: That doesn't fit this goal: take out no more than is saved, use today or an earlier day, and add money only to goals you fund yourself.
EXPENSE_LEDGER_FULL: This is full: it can't take more money in or out. Start a new one to carry on.
EXPENSE_RECURRING_NOT_DUE: That isn't a due date of this bill yet. Mark the next one paid first.
EXPENSE_SETTLEMENT_INVALID: That payment doesn't fit this loan: pay back no more than is left, on a day from the loan's date to today.
EXPENSE_IOU_BELOW_SETTLED: The amount can't be less than what has been paid back already.
AUTH_TWO_FACTOR_CODE_INVALID: That code is wrong or was already used. Try the newest code.
AUTH_TWO_FACTOR_CHALLENGE_INVALID: That sign-in took too long. Please sign in again.
AUTH_TWO_FACTOR_NOT_SET_UP: Start the setup again, then enter a code.
AUTH_TWO_FACTOR_UNAVAILABLE: Two-step sign-in isn't available on this server right now.
ACCOUNT_CONFIRM_MISMATCH: That isn't your email address. Type it exactly.
ACCOUNT_LAST_ADMIN: You're the only admin. Make someone else an admin first.
ADMIN_SELF_CHANGE: Change your own account from your Security page.
ALLOWLIST_EXISTS: That email is already on the list.
ALLOWLIST_IN_SETTINGS: That email is set in the server settings and can only be removed there.
AUTH_GOOGLE_REAUTH_REQUIRED: That Google sign-in is too old or isn't for this account. Sign in with Google again.
ADMIN_LAST_ADMIN: At least one active admin must remain.
PUSH_UNAVAILABLE: Notifications on devices aren't set up on this server.
PUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED: This browser's notification service isn't one the server sends to.
AGENT_PHOTO_TYPE: That isn't a photo this app can read. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
AGENT_PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: That photo is too large to send.
FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED: That kind of file can't be kept here. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
MODULE_NOT_GRANTABLE: That module is everyone's already: there is nothing to give.
RECEIPT_DATE_INVALID: A receipt can't be dated after today.
RECEIPT_WARRANTY_INVALID: A warranty ends on or after the day of buying, and within the longest warranty taken.
LABOR_DAY_IN_FUTURE: Attendance is recorded for today or a day before it.
LABOR_WAGE_DATE_INVALID: A new wage starts today or on a day before it.
LABOR_PERIOD_INVALID: Choose a period that runs from a day to a later one, and isn't too long.
LABOR_PROJECTS_FULL: That's as many projects as one owner keeps.
LABOR_PROJECT_CLOSED: That project is closed: reopen it first.
LABOR_PROJECT_STATE: That project is already that way.
LABOR_WORKERS_FULL: That's as many workers as one project keeps.
LABOR_WORKER_CODE_TAKEN: Another worker in this project has that number.
LABOR_WORKER_STATE: That worker is already that way.
LABOR_WORKER_UNKNOWN: That worker isn't in this project, or isn't working now.
LABOR_MARK_CHANGED: This mark was changed on another device since. Open the day to set it again.
LABOR_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: That's more days and payments than one file takes. Choose a shorter period.
